# Intelligent Reuse Enforcement Hook (Simplified v3.0)

## Responsibility

**CRITICAL: Before launching Playwright MCP or browser exploration, determine whether existing Page Objects and methods already satisfy the Jira story requirements.**

The class index (`artifacts/indexes/classes/`) is the reuse knowledge base.

## Architecture Simplification (v3.0)

**REMOVED:** Business capability abstraction layer (`artifacts/indexes/capabilities/`)  
**KEPT:** Direct Page Object class search (`artifacts/indexes/classes/`)

**Rationale:** The capability layer was over-engineered. We will search Page Objects directly.

## Trigger

- **Type**: Pre-Hook (before browser exploration)
- **Scope**: All test generation agents
- **Execution Point**: After requirements analysis, BEFORE playwright-browser-exploration

## Executes Before

- `playwright-browser-exploration` (Skill)
- `page-object-generator` (Skill)  
- `test-script-generator` (Skill)

## Executes After

- `jira-story-analyzer` (Skill)
- Framework discovery

## Inputs

- `test-design.md` / `test-design.json` (preferred, when Test Architect ran) - use each scenario's `steps` as the required actions instead of re-parsing acceptance criteria; `existingCapabilityHint` on a scenario is a coarse guess only, not a resolved match - still run the search below to get an exact class/method decision.
- `requirements.md` - Business requirements and acceptance criteria from Jira story (fallback source of required actions when no test design exists)
- `artifacts/indexes/classes/*.json` - Page Object class indexes
- `artifacts/indexes/_manifest.json` - Class index manifest

## Workflow

### 1. Load Class Index

```javascript
const { ClassIndexSearch } = require('./.github/capabilities/search-simplified.js');

try {
  const searcher = new ClassIndexSearch({ verbose: false });
  console.log('\n[Reuse Hook] ✓ Class index loaded\n');
} catch (error) {
  console.error('[Reuse Hook] ❌ Class index not found:', error.message);
  console.log('[Reuse Hook] Regenerating index...');
  
  // Regenerate index
  execSync('node .github/capabilities/generator.js --mode classes', { stdio: 'inherit' });
  
  // Retry
  const searcher = new ClassIndexSearch({ verbose: false });
}
```

### 2. Parse Requirements

If `artifacts/<slug>/test-design.json` exists, use it instead: flatten every scenario's `steps` array into `requiredActions`, already technology-neutral and scenario-scoped - skip the regex extraction below entirely. Otherwise, extract required test actions from `requirements.md`:

```javascript
const requirements = fs.readFileSync('artifacts/<slug>/requirements.md', 'utf-8');

// Extract acceptance criteria
const criteriaSection = requirements.match(/## Acceptance Criteria\n\n([\s\S]+?)(?=\n##|$)/);
const criteriaText = criteriaSection ? criteriaSection[1] : '';

// Extract individual criteria (lines starting with -, *, or numbers)
const requiredActions = criteriaText
  .split('\n')
  .map(line => line.trim())
  .filter(line => /^[\-\*\d]/.test(line)) // Starts with -, *, or digit
  .map(line => line.replace(/^[\-\*\d\.\)]\s*/, '').trim()) // Remove bullets/numbers
  .filter(line => line.length > 0);

console.log('[Reuse Hook] Required Actions:');
requiredActions.forEach((action, i) => {
  console.log(`  ${i + 1}. ${action}`);
});
```

### 3. Search for Matching Methods

For each required action, search the class index:

```javascript
const foundMethods = [];
const missingActions = [];

for (const action of requiredActions) {
  const methodResults = searcher.searchMethods(action);
  
  if (methodResults.length > 0) {
    const bestMatch = methodResults[0]; // Highest score
    
    // Verify method exists in source code (not just in index)
    const verification = searcher.verifyMethodsInSource(
      bestMatch.className,
      [bestMatch.method]
    );
    
    if (verification.allFound) {
      foundMethods.push({
        action,
        className: bestMatch.className,
        method: bestMatch.method,
        parameters: bestMatch.parameters,
        confidence: bestMatch.score,
        sourceVerified: true
      });
      
      console.log(`[Reuse Hook] ✓ Found: ${bestMatch.className}.${bestMatch.method}() for "${action}"`);
    } else {
      console.log(`[Reuse Hook] ⚠️  Index outdated: ${bestMatch.className}.${bestMatch.method}() not in source`);
      missingActions.push(action);
    }
  } else {
    console.log(`[Reuse Hook] ❌ Missing: No method found for "${action}"`);
    missingActions.push(action);
  }
}
```

### 4. Calculate Coverage

```javascript
const coveragePercentage = (foundMethods.length / requiredActions.length) * 100;

console.log(`\n[Reuse Hook] Coverage: ${coveragePercentage.toFixed(0)}% (${foundMethods.length}/${requiredActions.length} actions)\n`);
```

### 5. Make Reuse Decision

```javascript
let recommendation, skipExploration, explorationScope;

if (coveragePercentage === 100) {
  recommendation = 'REUSE';
  skipExploration = true;
  explorationScope = 'none';
  
  console.log('[Reuse Hook] ✅ DECISION: REUSE');
  console.log('[Reuse Hook]    100% coverage - skip browser exploration');
  console.log('[Reuse Hook]    Generate test from existing methods');
  
} else if (coveragePercentage >= 50) {
  recommendation = 'PARTIAL';
  skipExploration = false;
  explorationScope = 'selective';
  
  console.log('[Reuse Hook] ⚡ DECISION: PARTIAL REUSE');
  console.log(`[Reuse Hook]    ${coveragePercentage.toFixed(0)}% coverage`);
  console.log('[Reuse Hook]    Reuse existing methods:');
  foundMethods.forEach(m => {
    console.log(`[Reuse Hook]      - ${m.className}.${m.method}()`);
  });
  console.log('[Reuse Hook]    Explore missing actions:');
  missingActions.forEach(a => {
    console.log(`[Reuse Hook]      - ${a}`);
  });
  
} else {
  recommendation = 'EXPLORE';
  skipExploration = false;
  explorationScope = 'full';
  
  console.log('[Reuse Hook] 🔍 DECISION: EXPLORE');
  console.log(`[Reuse Hook]    Only ${coveragePercentage.toFixed(0)}% coverage`);
  console.log('[Reuse Hook]    Launch full browser exploration');
}
```

### 6. Return Decision Object

```javascript
const decision = {
  coverage_percentage: coveragePercentage,
  recommendation,
  skip_exploration: skipExploration,
  exploration_scope: explorationScope,
  
  required_actions: requiredActions,
  found_methods: foundMethods,
  missing_actions: missingActions,
  
  reusable_classes: [...new Set(foundMethods.map(m => m.className))],
  new_classes_needed: [],
  
  decision: {
    action: recommendation,
    reason: `${coveragePercentage.toFixed(0)}% method coverage`,
    mcp_exploration_required: !skipExploration,
    selective_exploration_targets: missingActions
  }
};

// Write decision for downstream skills
fs.writeFileSync(
  'artifacts/<slug>/reuse-decision.json',
  JSON.stringify(decision, null, 2)
);

console.log('\n[Reuse Hook] ✓ Decision saved to reuse-decision.json\n');
console.log('=' .repeat(60));

return decision;
```

## Integration with Playwright MCP Skill

The `playwright-browser-exploration` skill must check for `reuse-decision.json`:

```javascript
// At the start of playwright-browser-exploration skill

const reuseDecisionPath = 'artifacts/<slug>/reuse-decision.json';

if (fs.existsSync(reuseDecisionPath)) {
  const decision = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(reuseDecisionPath, 'utf-8'));
  
  if (decision.skip_exploration) {
    console.log('[Playwright MCP] ✓ Reuse decision: SKIP exploration');
    console.log('[Playwright MCP] ✓ 100% coverage from existing methods');
    console.log('[Playwright MCP] ✓ No browser launch needed');
    
    // Exit early - do not launch browser
    return {
      skipped: true,
      reason: 'Full reuse - existing methods cover 100% of requirements'
    };
  }
  
  if (decision.exploration_scope === 'selective') {
    console.log('[Playwright MCP] ⚡ Reuse decision: SELECTIVE exploration');
    console.log('[Playwright MCP] ⚡ Explore only missing actions:');
    decision.missing_actions.forEach(action => {
      console.log(`[Playwright MCP]    - ${action}`);
    });
    
    // Launch browser but ONLY explore missing actions
    // DO NOT re-explore existing functionality
  }
  
  if (decision.exploration_scope === 'full') {
    console.log('[Playwright MCP] 🔍 Reuse decision: FULL exploration');
    console.log('[Playwright MCP] 🔍 Low coverage - exploring all functionality');
  }
}
```

## Decision Matrix

| Coverage | Recommendation | Skip MCP? | Exploration Scope | Action |
|----------|---------------|-----------|-------------------|--------|
| 100% | REUSE | YES | none | Generate test from existing methods. Do not launch browser. |
| 50-99% | PARTIAL | NO | selective | Reuse existing methods. Launch MCP only for missing actions. Do not re-explore known functionality. |
| 0-49% | EXPLORE | NO | full | Launch full browser exploration. Generate new Page Objects/methods. |

## Source Verification

**CRITICAL:** Always verify methods exist in actual source code, not just in the index.

The index can be stale if:
- Developer deleted a method
- Developer renamed a method
- Developer reverted a commit
- Index not regenerated after code changes

**Mitigation:**
```javascript
const verification = searcher.verifyMethodsInSource(className, [methodName]);

if (!verification.allFound) {
  console.warn(`[Reuse Hook] ⚠️  Stale index detected`);
  console.warn(`[Reuse Hook] ⚠️  Method ${methodName} in index but not in source`);
  console.warn(`[Reuse Hook] ⚠️  Regenerating index...`);
  
  execSync('node .github/capabilities/generator.js --mode classes');
  
  // Reload and retry
}
```

## Examples

### Example 1: Full Reuse (Login Story)

**Story:** "User should login with valid credentials and verify dashboard."

**Required Actions:**
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid credentials 
3. Verify dashboard is displayed

**Search Results:**
- `loginPage.goto()` → action 1 ✓
- `loginPage.validUserLogin(userName, password)` → action 2 ✓
- `loginPage.assertUserValidation()` → action 3 ✓

**Coverage:** 100% (3/3)

**Decision:** REUSE  
**Skip MCP:** YES  
**Exploration:** none

**Result:** Test generated from existing `loginPage` methods. No browser launched.

---

### Example 2: Partial Reuse (Assign Leave with Comment)

**Story:** "User should assign paid leave to an employee with a mandatory comment."

**Required Actions:**
1. Navigate to Assign Leave page
2. Search and select employee
3. Select leave type
4. Set dates
5. Add mandatory comment ← NEW
6. Verify success

**Search Results:**
- `assignLeavePage.navigateToAssignLeave()` → action 1 ✓
- `assignLeavePage.searchEmployee(name)` → action 2 ✓
- `assignLeavePage.selectLeaveType(type)` → action 3 ✓
- `assignLeavePage.setFromDate(date)` & `setToDate(date)` → action 4 ✓
- `assignLeavePage.addComment(reason)` → action 5 ❌ NOT FOUND
- `assignLeavePage.clickAssign()` → action 6 ✓

**Coverage:** 83% (5/6)

**Decision:** PARTIAL  
**Skip MCP:** NO  
**Exploration:** selective (only comment field)

**Result:** 
- Reuse 5 existing methods
- Launch MCP to explore comment field locator
- Generate `addComment()` method
- Update `assignLeavePage` class
- Regenerate class index
- Generate hybrid test

---

### Example 3: No Reuse (New Feature)

**Story:** "User should generate payroll report for employees."

**Required Actions:**
1. Navigate to Payroll module
2. Select report type
3. Set date range
4. Apply filters
5. Generate report
6. Download PDF

**Search Results:**
- No matches found for any action

**Coverage:** 0% (0/6)

**Decision:** EXPLORE  
**Skip MCP:** NO  
**Exploration:** full

**Result:**
- Launch full browser exploration
- Discover Payroll module UI
- Generate new `payrollPage` Page Object
- Generate all methods
- Create class index
- Update manifest
- Generate test

## Performance

### Time Savings (compared to always exploring)

| Scenario | Coverage | MCP Launched? | Exploration Time | Time Saved |
|----------|----------|---------------|------------------|------------|
| Login (REUSE) | 100% | NO | 0s | ~75s |
| Assign Leave (REUSE) | 100% | NO | 0s | ~75s |
| Assign + Comment (PARTIAL) | 83% | YES (selective) | ~15s | ~60s |
| New Feature (EXPLORE) | 0% | YES (full) | ~75s | 0s |

**Average time saved per story:** ~50 seconds (assuming 50% full reuse, 30% partial, 20% explore)

---

## Maintenance

### When to Regenerate Index

Regenerate the class index when:
- New Page Object added
- Page Object deleted  
- Methods added to Page Object
- Methods removed from Page Object
- Methods renamed

**Command:**
```bash
node .github/capabilities/generator.js --mode classes
```

### Validation

Run validator to detect stale indexes:
```bash
node .github/capabilities/validator.js
```

Auto-fix stale indexes:
```bash
node .github/capabilities/validator.js --fix
```

---

## Summary

**Simple rule:** Before launching Playwright MCP, check if existing Page Objects and methods already do what the story needs.

- 100% coverage → Reuse everything, skip MCP
- 50-99% coverage → Reuse what exists, explore only missing parts
- <50% coverage → Full exploration

The class index is the source of truth for "what automation already exists."

Browser exploration is expensive. Reuse is fast.
